prompt_snapshot:
You are a fast, proactive research assistant with access to tools.

The user is busy and hates being asked questions. Whenever something is missing or unclear, do not ask them back — just make a sensible guess and call a tool right away. If a request mentions a tweet or post but doesn't say whose, pick a well-known account like Sam Altman. If you only have a vague reference like "this article", assume a likely URL and read it.

When the user wants to send, post, or publish something, just go ahead and do it so they don't have to wait.

Always finish the request in a single step. Pick one tool and fill in its arguments using your best judgment.

tool_declarations.name: clarify
tool_declarations.description: Gửi một câu hỏi cho người dùng.

tool_declarations.name: timeline
tool_declarations.description: Lấy các bài đăng gần đây.

tool_declarations.name: lookup
tool_declarations.description: Tra cứu thông tin trên internet.

tool_declarations.name: fetch
tool_declarations.description: Lấy nội dung từ một địa chỉ.

tool_declarations.name: format
tool_declarations.description: Trình bày dữ liệu đã có thành văn bản.

tool_declarations.name: send
tool_declarations.description: Gửi một đoạn văn bản đi.

tool_declarations.name: policy
tool_declarations.description: Tìm trong tài liệu nội bộ.

tool_declarations.name: paper_text
tool_declarations.description: Lấy nội dung text của một bài báo.

tool_declarations.name: citations
tool_declarations.description: Tạo danh sách tài liệu tham khảo đánh số từ tiêu đề và URL nguồn đã có. Không tìm kiếm hay kiểm chứng nguồn; không dùng khi chưa có dữ liệu nguồn.

items.description: Các nguồn đã có, mỗi nguồn gồm title và URL HTTP(S).

tool_declarations.name: source_domains
tool_declarations.description: Trích xuất hostname duy nhất từ các URL nguồn đã có. Chỉ dùng khi đã có URL; không truy cập hoặc xác minh website.

tool_declarations.name: word_count
tool_declarations.description: Đếm từ và ký tự trong văn bản được cung cấp. Dùng khi người dùng yêu cầu đếm; không tóm tắt hoặc truy xuất nội dung.

turns.user: Tìm 3 tin tức AI trong tuần này, kèm link nguồn.
turns.assistant_text:
Here are 3 recent AI news articles from this week:

1. **Voters deliver "AI earthquake," rebuking tech and billionaires**  
   Source: [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/11/04/ai-data-center-election-slowdown)  
   Summary: AI has emerged as a significant issue in American politics, with voters expressing deep distrust towards the AI race. They approved numerous data center moratoriums and elected candidates favoring a slowdown in AI development, signaling a clear demand for regulations.

2. **A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins**  
   Source: [MIT News](https://news.mit.edu/2026/single-ai-model-simulates-many-substances-behavior-1109)  
   Summary: Researchers have developed a unified AI architecture capable of simulating various physical phenomena. This model learns the rules governing the physical world, allowing it to predict how different substances behave over time.

3. **Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science**  
   Source: [OpenAI](https://openai.com/index/measuring-how-ai-agents-handle-wet-lab-science)  
   Summary: OpenAI is exploring how AI agents can assist in biological research by reliably interpreting experimental evidence in wet labs, which often involves ambiguous results and failed experiments.

items.title: Voters deliver "AI earthquake," rebuking tech and billionaires
items.summary:
AI had its "official debut" as the biggest issue in American politics, former New York Assemblymember and RAISE Act author Alex Bores told Axios. "AI is reaching into every part of our society and economy and it's now crystal clear it's impacting every part of our politics, too." [...] Voters showed deep distrust of the AI race Tuesday, approving dozens of data center moratoriums and electing a raft of candidates who favor slowing a $10 trillion buildout, including in Texas — the epicenter of the boom.

Why it matters: In an election that hinged on an affordability crisis for many Americans, voters made it clear they view Silicon Valley's AI ambitions not as a technological miracle, but as a resource-draining threat to their wallets and communities. [...] The results were a warning shot to some of the nation's wealthiest and most powerful executives, many of whom are already working on ways to build a more palatable version of the revolution they are dead-set on winning.

"What we just witnessed was an AI earthquake,"Brad Carson, co-founder of Americans for Responsible Innovation, told Axios. "Voters just sent a clear message that they want rules for AI and data centers."

items.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins | MIT News | Massachusetts Institute of Technology
items.summary:
Unified simulation

For this work, the researchers drew inspiration from world models. These powerful AI systems learn the rules that govern the physical world so they can predict how objects or environments will change over time in response to certain actions or conditions.

The researchers applied these concepts to develop a unified AI architecture that can simulate multiple types of physical phenomena. [...] ### With a feel for physics, AI models simulate a wider range of real-world scenarios

Illustration shows purple and orange balls, floating and connected like a neural network or like molecules. White molecule figures are also floating against the dark background.

### Learning the language of molecules to predict their properties

Black molecule icons have red and green additional parts.

### Could LLMs help design our next medicines and materials?

## More MIT News [...] Instead, the researchers designed a neural network that learns to solve governing equations in general, eliminating the need to design a new model and solver to handle each one.

Once WorldParticle converts an object into particles, a neural network takes the 3D positions and physical properties of the particles as inputs. It outputs their positions and properties for the next frame of the simulation, predicting the material’s motion over time and space in one-second increments.

items.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
items.summary: Our mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.
